item.title: [ 34] Wife beater MAGA Max Miller posts nude image and personal details of his 2-year-old daughter
item.description:
Miller's attorney blames a missed page for the leak as Sen. Bernie Moreno calls it grotesque and Miller now asks for his own House ethics probe before an Aug. 10 ballot deadline.

https://tiffinohio.net/posts/miller-nude-image-2-year-old-daughter-evidence-dump/

Moments before he posted a link to hundreds of messages, recordings and images from his divorce, U.S. Rep. Max Miller told a livestream audience why he was doing it.

“This isn’t about defending myself,” the Ohio Republican said. “I’m speaking up as a father, trying to protect our daughter.”

The folder he shared Sunday with his nearly 60,000 followers on X contained an image of that daughter, who is 2 years old, nude, CNN reported Tuesday. The image was publicly available for at least a day before it was taken down.

Miller’s personal attorney, Aaron Minc, has taken responsibility for it. “Unfortunately, I missed the last three pages of a 40+ page document with sensitive content,” Minc said in a statement to CNN. “It was completely unintentional and a mistake. The moment I discovered the issue on Monday morning, I corrected the file immediately.”

Minc said he made multiple passes through the material to strip out sensitive details, including the child’s name. CNN reported that an earlier version of the public file it reviewed included the child’s name dozens of times, along with payment records to medical providers and several images of her.

“I am truly sorry to Congressman Miller, Ms. Moreno, both of their families, and, especially, to their daughter,” Minc said. “I deeply regret the mistake.”

item.title: [294] TLOK
item.description:
People didn’t want growth, they wanted another plot-armored comfort show like ATLA and got pissed when the writers actually matured.

Korra’s trauma across four seasons wasn’t the writers “ruining” her legacy. It was them refusing to hand her the same invincible-hero safety net Aang got. They made her lose, break, deal with real PTSD, and still choose to keep going. That’s not bad writing that’s modern, adult storytelling.

Aang was the idealized Avatar. Korra was the human one. The fact that we’re still arguing about it years later proves it worked.

item.title: [129] Mamdani Does the Big Funny: Centrally Planned Grocery Stores
item.description:
> https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/02/mamdani-grocery-store-plan-new-york

Carlos Collado, a Dominican immigrant who owns five independent grocery stores in the Bronx and Manhattan, has succeeded over the last three decades despite obstacles that he blames on local and state governance.

His stores have faced an increase in shoplifting, he said. The city has provided tax benefits to big corporations that opened grocery stores and took business away from his.

Now, he says, New York’s new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, will make it even harder for him and other grocery store and bodega owners to succeed because of his plan to open five city-owned grocers. The mayor announced additional details about the stores this week, which he said will offer produce, meat and seafood for 30% less than typical retail prices.

Existing businesses will not be able to compete, Collado and some others say. But there is also support for Mamdani’s venture, saying that the stores will bring much-need food options into areas of New York city sorely lacking in grocery shops and help with a crisis in soaring food prices that hits some of the city’s most vulnerable families the hardest.

Food costs in the United States have soared in recent years. item.title: [ 45] Never heard of coldcard before, but i have autism and a software engineer by tr
item.description:
Never heard of coldcard before, but i have autism and a software engineer by trade. Here is what I found.

The Coldcard wallet hack was not a breach of the Bitcoin network as some retards claim, but rather an exploit of a severe firmware flaw that allowed a specific attacker to guess users' private keys offline. (Company should be sued for this with a class action on coinkite. This screams criminal negligence)

he vulnerability resulted in the theft of over $75 million in Bitcoin (1,158+ BTC) across thousands of addresses they used computers to "fast guess" the software addresses.

Coinkite, who makes the devices, did not do this intentionally, but is 100% liable. This "hack" is elementary in nature and I'm willing to point the finger on them to either knowingly leaving the bug in or didn't audit the incoming code. Their are tools we use in the software engineering world that will check for bug like this. This should have have been a thing. EVER.

A hardware wallet’s sole job is to generate absolute randomness (entropy) to create a private key that is impossible to guess. If the randomness is predictable, the keys can be reverse-engineered. From what I can tell, the bug was applied with firmware version 4.0.0 in March 2021.

Because the hardware RNG was bypassed, the software PRNG relied on highly predictable variables to seed its "randomness".

This also means, the attacker did not need to physically touch or hack into the Coldcard devices, because the underlying variables were limited and predictable, the hacker recreated the candidate output streams completely offline using custom software they built for the purpose.

TL;DR - They either chose to not audit the incoming code back in March 2021 with the bug in it, or they let it go through on purpose. Either way, they should be sued into the ground for this and answers gathered in court as to way no one caught it And I'm wondering if they hid it through obfuscation.

item.title: [150] /twg/ - Taiwan General
item.description:
> why no Taiwan general in the catalog edition, grok writing the OP edition

Quick Start Guide for First Timers:

Visa: Most countries get 90 days visa-free. Check if you need an eVisa or ARC if staying longer. Fill out your arrival card online before arriving for less stress.
Best Time: Oct–Dec for perfect weather (dry season). Avoid July–Sept typhoon season unless you like rain and chaos.
Getting Around: Taipei MRT is clean, cheap, and efficient as fuck. Youbike only needs an easy card and is essentially free unless you want to ride for hours.
High Speed Rail (HSR) for city hopping (Taipei Kaohsiung in ~1.5h).
Scooters are god outside Taipei. Get an international permit if you plan to ride.
Uber works but taxis are cheap. Avoid during rush hour or rain.

Food:

Night markets are mandatory. Shilin, Raohe, Ningxia, etc.
Must eats: Beef noodle soup, stinky tofu (acquired taste), oyster omelettes, bubble tea (original homeland), pineapple cake, mango shaved ice. All you can eat hotpot also.
7-11 and FamilyMart are better than in most countries, you can live off them if you want.

Top Spots:

Taipei: 101, Jiufen old street, Beitou hot springs, temples everywhere.
Taroko Gorge (east coast) — absolute kino nature.
Sun Moon Lake, Kenting (beaches), Alishan for mountains.
East coast for chill vibes and fewer tourists.

General Tips:

Taiwanese people are polite and helpful. Learn basic Mandarin or use Google Translate.
Tipping is not expected.

Useful Links & Services:

Official Taiwan Tourism: https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/
YouBike: https://en.youbike.com.tw/
